==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Lucio:''' If only I had a golden whip. I could double the number of Tumbleyaks with a gentle flick in the morning! Then, in a month—
:'''Lucio:''' I'd turn all the Tumbleyak milk into cheese for Giovanetta to make pizzas! Then I could eat as many as I wanted!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Lucio:''' Do you think if we doubled the Tumbleyak every day, would we have enough credits at the end of the month to send Julia to see a play in Ragunna?
:{{DIcon}} Do you really know what 2 to the power of 30 is...?
:'''Lucio:''' What? What does "power" mean? Sorry, I actually never went to school.
:'''Lucio:''' If we have that many Tumbleyaks... Pela won't have to herd them anymore, right?
{{Dialogue End}}
